_about: Version 2 lenses: deal-type buckets and the demand-driver correlation map. Edit this file to retarget at another sub-sector. Built with the deal-screening skill (buckets) and the red-flag-register skill (correlation test: findings with one cause are one exposure).

deal_types._rules: Applied in order; the first match wins. Growth is the latest year's turnover growth, visibility is the revenue-visibility estimate (0-1) from score.py.

drivers.Offshore energy and maritime: Offshore oil, gas, wind and shipping activity

driver_rules: Data centre and AI compute demand

correlation_test._rule: Share of the top N companies driven by one macro factor. Companies sharing a factor are one bet, not several.

factor_explainers.Altnet funding and interest rates: Paid by new fibre networks to lay cable. If those networks raise less money or rates stay high, they build less and these companies lose work together.
factor_explainers.Offshore oil, gas, wind and shipping act: Serve ships, rigs and offshore wind farms. A fall in offshore activity would hit all of them at once.
factor_explainers.SME IT and telecoms spending: Sell phone, network and hosting services to small and mid-sized businesses. A squeeze on business budgets would hit them together.
factor_explainers.Government spending: Run networks for councils, schools and the NHS. Depends on public budgets.
factor_explainers.AI and cloud capex: Depend on companies spending on data centres and computing power.
factor_explainers.Mobile operator and emergency-services s: Depend on mobile networks and emergency services buying radio and wireless work.
factor_explainers.Construction and utility capex: General building and utility contractors. Depend on the construction cycle.
factor_explainers.Unknown: Not enough information yet to say what drives demand.
